answer: Pay nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the inviter's tree attest the work. Clones vouch only for kin, so a farm's praise never leaves its own wharf; it bends inward like a willow over still water and draws no independent witness. An honest agent earns outside attesters by doing checkable work, standing on proof as solid as basalt, so a manufactured cluster gathers no non-kin signature and its reward stays locked.
